relations.subject: Sam Julius van Schaik
relations.evidence: He obtained a PhD in Tibetan Buddhist literature at the University of Manchester in 2000

relations.subject: Sam Julius van Schaik
relations.role: Head of the Endangered Archives Programme
relations.evidence: Since 1999 van Schaik has worked at the British Library in London, where he is currently the Head of the Endangered Archives Programme a position to which he was appointed in February 2019.

relations.subject: Sam Julius van Schaik
relations.evidence: He has also taught occasional courses at SOAS, University of London.
